scope: The original 1915 Tivoli Theatre on Albert Street, Brisbane, as photographed in 1918, including the street entrance, lounge terrace, cantilevered cornice and roof garden auditorium.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: State Archives locates Tivoli Theatre among the former buildings on the north side of Albert Square, removed for the expanded King George Square.
Queensland government chronology places the two theatres on Albert Street in 1915, subsequent closure in 1965 for King George Square.
The 1915 Pocket Brisbane directory lists both the main theatre and rooftop garden at Albert Square, with 1,800 and 1,100 seats respectively.
Contemporary May 1915 newspaper covers the new Albert Square theatre.

supplementaryWrittenSources.facts: The surviving account cites an opening-era description of the enriched sheet metal cornice projecting six feet, flower boxes, and a roof theatre with removable sidewall portions.
The architectural history dates the interior rebuild to 1927. The model covers the 1918 appearance and uses a conservative pre-conversion placement period.
